test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who loves music
solution: The correct answer is: **Melophile**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Melophile"** refers to a person who loves or is deeply passionate about music. (संगीत प्रेमी) • **Example:** As a melophile, she spends hours curating playlists that reflect her moods. • **"Melophile"** is derived from "melo-" (from melody, meaning music) and "-phile" (meaning lover). It specifically indicates someone who has a strong affection for music. (संगीत के प्रति गहरा प्रेम) • **Example:** His love for classical symphonies proves he is a true melophile. • Hence, the word that best matches the description of "a person who loves music" is **"Melophile."** Therefore, the correct answer is: **Melophile**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Chromatophilic** (रंग प्रेमी): Refers to an affinity for colors or pigments. • **Example:** Artists are often chromatophilic because of their fascination with colors. • **Discophile** (डिस्क प्रेमी): Refers to a person who collects or is passionate about records or vinyl discs. • **Example:** The discophile spends weekends searching for rare vinyl records at flea markets. • **Astrophile** (तारों और आकाश प्रेमी): Refers to someone who loves stars and astronomy. • **Example:** As an astrophile, he spends nights stargazing with his telescope. Question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. **The correct answer is: Melophile**. 19d:T157f, ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರ: **ಮೆಲೋಫಿಲ್ (Melophile)**.
